feature_docs.est_snr_db: dB, [-10,50]. 10log10((P_y - s2)/s2); s2 = 16*mean|h16[n>=12]|^2 (pilot-CIR tail noise estimate); P_y = mean received power.
feature_docs.pilot_res_power: unitless, >=0. mean|H_p - LP(H_p)|^2 / mean|H_p|^2, LP = pilot-domain CIR truncated to CP_LEN/2 taps. Non-trivial residual (noise + long delay tail); averaged over frames.
feature_docs.delay_spread_proxy: samples, [0,~5]. RMS delay spread of the noise-floor-corrected 16-tap pilot CIR power profile (taps<12), averaged over frames.
feature_docs.chan_variation: unitless, >=0. mean|diff_k H_LS[k]| over subcarriers (frequency selectivity / noise roughness), averaged over frames.
feature_docs.deep_fade_ratio: fraction in [0,1]. share of subcarriers with |H_LS| < 0.3.
feature_docs.zf_noise_enhance_log: log10 of mean(1/max(|H_LS|^2,1e-6)): proxy for ZF noise boost.
feature_docs.doppler_proxy: unitless, >=0. max(0, mean|H_p[n]-H_p[n-1]|^2 - 2 s2) / mean|H_p|^2 : frame-to-frame channel change beyond noise (0 for single-frame bursts).
feature_docs.chan_est_corr: [-1,1]. mean over consecutive frames of Re<H_p[n],H_p[n-1]>/(|H_p[n]||H_p[n-1]|) (1 for single-frame bursts).

label_objective: argmin( BER + 0.0001*(C/Cmax + SE_loss) ); ties -> lowest id
